zh: 按右端点统计子串：以位置 i 结尾的合法子串，起点不能越过最近的一个辅音，并且起点要足够靠左，使五种元音都至少出现一次。
记录五种元音各自最近出现的位置和最近辅音的位置；以 i 结尾时，合法起点恰好落在“最近辅音之后”到“五个最近元音位置的最小值”这一段里。
初始化 last[a,e,i,o,u]=−1、bad=−1、answer=0；对每个字符，若是元音则更新它的 last，否则 bad=i；然后 answer 加上 max(0, min(last)−bad)。答案可能很大，用 64 位整数。
en: Count substrings by their right end: a valid substring ending at position i cannot start at or before the latest consonant, and its start must be far enough left that all five vowels appear at least once.

Track the latest position of each of the five vowels and the latest consonant. For a right end i, the valid starts are exactly the positions after the latest consonant and no later than the minimum of the five latest vowel positions.

Initialize last[a, e, i, o, u] = -1, bad = -1, answer = 0. For each character, update its last entry if it is a vowel, otherwise set bad = i; then add max(0, min(last) - bad) to answer. The answer can be large, so use a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Track the latest position of each of the five vowels and of the latest consonant. For each right end, the number of valid starts is min(latest vowel positions) - latest consonant position, or 0 if that is negative.

## Correctness

A valid start must come after the latest consonant and be no later than the latest position of every vowel; these two conditions give exactly one closed interval. After counting it, every substring is classified uniquely by its right end.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(1) space.
